offerStep: Offer, conditions, tuition deposit and CoE
visaStep: Student visa file, health and biometrics where requested
specialTiming: February and July are the main intakes, but some programmes use other starts. Always check the exact course deadline.

offerStep: Offer, conditions, tuition and financial plan
visaStep: Fee Paying Student Visa file, police and health evidence where required
specialTiming: February and July are common. Provider calendars can also use trimesters, blocks or additional starts.

offerStep: Offer, credibility checks, deposit and CAS
visaStep: TB certificate, maintenance evidence and Student visa
specialTiming: September has the widest choice. CAS deadlines can close before the course start and vary by university.

offerStep: Admission, DLI and PAL or TAL checks where required
visaStep: Study permit, financial evidence, biometrics and medical where required
specialTiming: September is the largest intake. Programme, campus, PGWP and PAL or TAL status should be checked together.

offerStep: Admission decision, funding proof and I-20
visaStep: SEVIS, DS-160, F-1 visa interview and travel preparation
specialTiming: Fall is the main intake. Testing, essays, scholarships and funding can make 12+ months of lead time valuable.

offerStep: Offer, tuition payment and finance preparation
visaStep: Long-stay study visa and private medical insurance
specialTiming: September offers the widest choice. Long-stay study visa applications can generally be made up to three months before travel.

offerStep: Admission, scholarship decisions and solvency route
visaStep: Visa D, blocked account or sponsor evidence and travel preparation
specialTiming: Non-EEA and scholarship deadlines can be much earlier than the September start, often from January through spring.

offerStep: Admission, canton and financial-evidence preparation
visaStep: Visa D and cantonal authorization process
specialTiming: Autumn is the main start. Bangladesh guidance currently indicates visa processing can take roughly 8 to 12 weeks.

offerStep: Admission, tuition and SIRI preparation
visaStep: SIRI residence permit and self-support evidence
specialTiming: Many non-Danish undergraduate qualifications use a 15 March deadline. Some non-EU Masters deadlines can be in January.

offerStep: Studyinfo application, admission, tuition and scholarship outcome
visaStep: Migri residence permit and first-year funding evidence
specialTiming: The January joint application is the main international application window for many autumn-start English-taught programmes.

offerStep: Admission, tuition and recognised-sponsor immigration process
visaStep: MVV and residence permit process where applicable
specialTiming: Numerus fixus programmes can use a 15 January deadline. Non-EEA deadlines can also be earlier because of immigration and housing.

offerStep: Admission, tuition where applicable and maintenance funds
visaStep: UDI study permit, housing and document submission
specialTiming: August is the main start. Many English-taught programmes can close in December or January for applicants who need permits.

offerStep: UniversityAdmissions result, tuition and scholarship outcome
visaStep: Residence permit and maintenance evidence
specialTiming: The first international application round is designed to leave time for tuition, permits and housing. Autumn has the widest selection.

offerStep: Campus France or institution process, admission and language evidence
visaStep: France-Visas, Embassy process and VLS-TS preparation
specialTiming: French application calendars can begin almost a year early. Some first-year Licence routes use DAP deadlines well before September.

offerStep: Recognition where required, admission and tuition planning
visaStep: e-Konsulat, VFS, finances, insurance and D-type visa
specialTiming: Recognition and visa appointment steps can add substantial lead time even when the university deadline appears later.

offerStep: Homologación or UNEDasiss where needed, then university admission
visaStep: Study visa, financial evidence, insurance and BLS Dhaka submission
specialTiming: Bachelor recognition and UNEDasiss can add months. Start earlier than the university deadline suggests.

offerStep: Admission, language or preparatory conditions and finance plan
visaStep: Residence Permit Student and entry visa steps where required
specialTiming: October is the main start. General university dates can be around early September for winter and early February for summer, with programme exceptions.

offerStep: Qualification recognition and university admission
visaStep: Temporary residence, finance, insurance and travel preparation
specialTiming: October is the main start. Undergraduate recognition and national admissions steps can add time.

offerStep: Recognition, uni-assist or direct application, and admission
visaStep: Blocked-account or finance evidence and German student visa
specialTiming: Winter is the main intake. 15 July is a common winter deadline and 15 January a common summer deadline, but neither is universal.

offerStep: University application and recognition where relevant
visaStep: National visa and residence preparation
specialTiming: International Master deadlines vary widely. The special foreign-candidate public Bachelor route can use a summer application window.

offerStep: University evaluation, CIMEA or DoV where needed, then Universitaly
visaStep: Universitaly validation, financial file and student visa
specialTiming: International applications can open much earlier than the intake. Document verification and Universitaly can add substantial lead time.

offerStep: Academic recognition and institution admission
visaStep: MIGRIS, mediation process and residence permit submission
specialTiming: Recognition can add time before final admission and the residence process should be planned months ahead.

offerStep: Admission, document recognition and university confirmation
visaStep: D visa entry where applicable and temporary residence permit preparation
specialTiming: Most international degree study starts in autumn. Application periods commonly begin months earlier and deadlines are university-specific.

offerStep: University admission, interview or test where required, and scholarship outcome
visaStep: Residence permit / D visa preparation, finances and consular submission
specialTiming: September is the main intake. February is available for selected programmes, while Stipendium Hungaricum normally closes around mid-January.

offerStep: Admission, MQF and institution verification, tuition and finance plan
visaStep: Study D visa, insurance, biometrics and Dhaka VFS submission
specialTiming: October is the main university start. Identità recommends D-visa submission at least 8 weeks before the course and allows filing up to 6 months early.

offerStep: SII registration, admission offer, scholarship or fee-waiver outcome
visaStep: Student Visa application, Bangladesh document file and financial evidence
specialTiming: Many degree programmes begin around July or August, but institutions and scholarship schemes use their own calendars. Obtain the mandatory Study in India ID before the visa stage.

offerStep: University admission, CSCA or language evidence, scholarship outcome and JW201/JW202 preparation
visaStep: X1 or X2 visa, Bangladesh financial evidence and long-term residence preparation
specialTiming: September is the main degree intake. Scholarship deadlines often fall much earlier, and 2026 undergraduate applicants should plan the CSCA before the university application deadline.

offerStep: TR-YÖS or accepted exam result, university admission, scholarship outcome and enrolment preparation
visaStep: Education visa through Mosaic Visa, then student residence permit after arrival
specialTiming: Autumn is the main intake. Undergraduate applicants should plan around TR-YÖS and university application windows, while Türkiye Scholarships normally runs from 10 January to 20 February.

offerStep: Admission, scholarship decision, housing and university sponsorship confirmation
visaStep: Student entry and residence processing through the sponsoring university or eligible resident parent
specialTiming: September is the broadest intake, while January is common at many private and branch campuses. Visa and residence timing is institution-led, so confirm the university's own processing window.

offerStep: Qualification recognition, admission decision, study agreement and tuition payment
visaStep: Residence permit application in person at the Embassy of Latvia in New Delhi, then long-stay visa after OCMA approval
specialTiming: Autumn is the main intake. Bangladesh applicants should apply earlier than the final university deadline because the residence permit requires an in-person New Delhi step and additional examination.
